result.description: B2B support platform (Slack/Teams/email-based helpdesk) with issues, accounts, contacts, knowledge base, and AI agents.
result.auth_detail: Admin-created API token sent as Authorization: Bearer. Tokens do not expire. No OAuth2 for the public REST API; the official MCP server is OAuth-only.
result.access_detail: Any Pylon workspace Admin can create a token in Settings > API Tokens. No docs page found stating a paid-plan gate. Pylon itself is sales-led, so a workspace is needed first. Plan restrictions were not confirmed.
result.api_notes: REST API at api.usepylon.com (US) and api.eu.usepylon.com (EU). Covers issues, customers/accounts, contacts, knowledge base, and more, with an API reference for all endpoints. SDKs for TypeScript, Python and Go, plus an experimental CLI. A community server claims 114 endpoints (unverified). Endpoint count not stated in the official docs.
result.blocker: Auth is a bearer token created by a workspace Admin, which is a manual step for each user. Whether the API needs a paid plan is not documented. A user must already be a Pylon customer.

evidence.quote: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication.
Only Admins can create and manage API tokens.
Check out our API Reference for specifications on all endpoints.
The Pylon MCP server only supports OAuth authentication.
